svg.desc: Shadow 06 figure F6. Exact plotted values are encoded on marks.

g.data-value: Image / video / audio mark
C2PA signatures on supported generated files; separate multimedia watermark not found
SynthID watermark (portal also checks partners' content)
SynthID watermark + C2PA metadata on images; supported audio since Jul 2026
Text mark
A version of SynthID-Text on supported models, worldwide subject to model/feature/platform support
Text watermark: ChatGPT/Codex text marked by default in the EU only; API opt-in, off by default
g.text: text marked by default in the EU
only; API opt-in, off by default

g.data-value: Who can check (hosted)
Files: free content checker + C2PA tools; text: detection API in private preview
Public portal for images, video, audio
Images and audio: public verifier + API; text detector: approved researchers only
Detector code / verification tooling
Text production-detector source: not found. File credentials: verification with compatible C2PA tooling is documented, including the open-source c2patool.
SynthID-Text reference code public, incl. detection ("not intended for production")
Announced intent to open-source
Published text robustness evaluation
No Claude-specific numerical robustness evaluation comparable in reporting form to the other table entries was found
g.text: in reporting form to the other

g.data-value: Peer-reviewed (Nature 2024): evaluation incl. edits and paraphrasing; numbers in Supplementary C.6

Provider's own (5 Oct 2026), 1% FPR target: ~80% detected at 200 tokens, ~95% at 400 tokens (psychology); lower for mathematics. Synonym substitution on 400-token English answers: 10% of words → 92% to 66%; 25% → 17%
Self-stated limits
Short text weaker; mark is not complete authorship; missing credentials not human origin
g.text: Short text weaker; mark is not

g.data-value: Watermarks weakened by edits; vulnerable to stealing, spoofing and scrubbing; coordination among providers can broaden coverage
Absence of a mark does not establish human authorship
g.text: Absence of a mark does not

svg.text: Provider statements are attributed to the listed sources; the table is not an independent cross-provider test.
Figures come from different implementations, corpora and operating points. No ranking is implied.
